name: sessions
description: Returns a list of Checkout Sessions.

input.name: payment_intent
input.description: Only return the Checkout Session for the PaymentIntent specified

input.name: starting_after
input.description: A cursor for use in pagination. starting_after is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with obj_foo, your subsequent call can include starting_after=obj_foo in order to fetch the next page of the list.

input.name: limit
input.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned, between 1 and 100.

input.name: ending_before
input.description: A cursor for use in pagination. ending_before is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with obj_bar, your subsequent call can include ending_before=obj_bar in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

input.name: subscription
input.description: Only return the Checkout Session for the subscription specified.
